clips.title: The story
paras: On an island in Brightwater Lake, Gunther's Retreat shelters a renegade necromancer. Gunther Arcanus broke free of the Scourge through sheer will, but trusts no outsider and keeps undead minions around his camp.

Mist hangs over the waters around Gunther's Retreat, where undead sentinels guard a lonely camp. Gunther Arcanus was raised in undeath, but his arcane mastery let him tear his soul from the Lich King's grip without help. He mistrusted everyone and believed the undead wandering Lordaeron remained puppets of the Scourge. Gunther withdrew to the island to practice his craft in peace, and his zombie sentinels attack anyone who crosses the water.
